senses.en: the object form of who

ex.en: Whom did you ask for the key?
ex.zh: 你向谁要的钥匙？

ex.en: In formal writing, whom follows a preposition: the teacher to whom I wrote.
ex.zh: 正式写作里，whom 跟在介词后，例如 the teacher to whom I wrote。

tip: 口语里多用 who。介词后面的正式文体仍用 whom。

senses.en: a section of a book

ex.en: Read the next chapter before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前读下一章。

ex.en: The last chapter of a report should say what the school will actually do.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一章应当写学校实际上会做什么。

tip: chapter 可数。书的章用 chapter，文章的段用 paragraph。

senses.en: to accept something painful, or to carry a weight
a large heavy animal

ex.en: I cannot bear the noise in the hall.
ex.zh: 我受不了大厅里的噪音。

ex.en: The bridge can bear the weight of a bus, according to the sign.
ex.zh: 根据标牌，这座桥能承受一辆公交的重量。

tip: 忍受的过去式是 bore，过去分词是 borne。出生用 be born。名词 bear 是熊。

senses.en: a valuable yellow metal
made of gold

ex.en: The medal looks like gold.
ex.zh: 这块奖牌看起来像金子。

ex.en: A gold mine can bring wages and also leave a river too dirty to drink.
ex.zh: 金矿能带来工资，也会把河弄脏到不能喝。

tip: gold 作定语常表示材料：a gold ring。golden 多表示金色或珍贵。

senses.en: to make something more modern or add new information
new information, or a newer version

ex.en: Please update the class list.
ex.zh: 请更新班级名单。

ex.en: Schools should update an emergency number on the wall the day it changes.
ex.zh: 紧急电话一变，学校就应当当天改墙上的号码。

col: update sb on｜向某人更新情况
tip: update 也可作名词。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: practice to learn a skill

ex.en: The team has training on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 球队周三训练。

ex.en: Training for village teachers fails if it takes them away from class for a whole month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训让他们离开课堂整整一个月，培训就会失败。

tip: training 通常不可数。

senses.en: to focus attention
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: the food a person usually eats

ex.en: A balanced diet includes fruit.
ex.zh: 均衡的饮食包括水果。

ex.en: The canteen diet should be one a student can see and afford.
ex.zh: 食堂的饮食应当是学生看得见、也买得起的。

tip: diet 可数。on a diet 表示节食。表里这一行的音标是 die，本库不用。

senses.en: moving or happening quickly
quickly

ex.en: The early bus is fast, but it is often full.
ex.zh: 早班车很快，但常常满员。

ex.en: A fast road into the city helps drivers and can make the walk to school more dangerous.
ex.zh: 进城的快速路方便司机，也可能让走路上学更危险。

tip: fast 既可作形容词也可作副词，不加 -ly。fast 作副词不是 fastly。

senses.en: a machine that carries people or goods

ex.en: No vehicle may enter the playground.
ex.zh: 任何车辆不得进入操场。

ex.en: An electric vehicle still needs a safe place to charge near the school.
ex.zh: 电动车仍然需要学校附近一个安全的充电处。

tip: vehicle 是车辆的总称，包括汽车、公交和自行车在正式用语里有时也包括。

senses.en: a large organised group of soldiers

ex.en: The history book describes the army's long march.
ex.zh: 历史书写到军队的长途行军。

ex.en: An army can build a bridge quickly, but a town still needs people to maintain it.
ex.zh: 军队可以很快建起一座桥，但城镇仍需要人来维护它。

tip: army 作整体时谓语可用单数。

senses.en: in pieces, or not working

ex.en: The broken window was repaired before class.
ex.zh: 破碎的窗户在上课前修好了。

ex.en: A broken lift in a station matters most to travellers who cannot use the stairs.
ex.zh: 车站里坏掉的电梯，对不能走楼梯的旅客影响最大。

tip: broken 是 break 的过去分词，也可作形容词。

senses.en: work, especially physical work; American spelling

ex.en: The harvest needs extra labor in October.
ex.zh: 十月的收成需要额外的劳力。

ex.en: Fair labor rules matter when students take a weekend job to pay for books.
ex.zh: 学生周末打工买书时，公平的劳动规则就很重要。

tip: labor 是美式拼写，labour 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

senses.en: a large area of trees

ex.en: The path goes through a forest.
ex.zh: 这条小路穿过一片森林。

ex.en: A forest near a town cools the air and still needs a rule against leaving rubbish.
ex.zh: 城镇附近的森林能让空气变凉，也仍然需要禁止丢垃圾的规定。

tip: forest 比 wood 大。a forest，the forest 都可以。

senses.en: something people do, especially for a purpose

ex.en: The club plans one outdoor activity a month.
ex.zh: 社团每月安排一次户外活动。

ex.en: After-school activity should not depend only on families who can pay for extra lessons.
ex.zh: 课外活动不该只依靠付得起额外课程的家庭。

col: take part in an activity｜参加活动
tip: activity 表示具体活动时可数。不可数时指活跃或繁忙。

senses.en: a duty to deal with something

ex.en: It is your responsibility to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 锁实验室是你的责任。

ex.en: Responsibility for a flooded street is shared by the town, not only by the family on the ground floor.
ex.zh: 被淹街道的责任在城镇，而不只在一楼那户人家。

tip: 对某事负责：be responsible for。

senses.en: a place larger than a village and smaller than a city

ex.en: Our town has one public library.
ex.zh: 我们镇上有一座公共图书馆。

ex.en: A small town loses young people when the college, the jobs, and the buses are all in the city.
ex.zh: 当大学、工作和公交都在城里时，小镇会失去年轻人。

tip: town 比 city 小。in town 常不加 the。

senses.en: living naturally, or not controlled
a natural place far from towns

ex.en: Wild birds nest in the trees by the river.
ex.zh: 野鸟在河边的树上筑巢。

ex.en: A wild hillside above a town can become a park, or it can become the next row of houses.
ex.zh: 城镇上方的荒坡可以变成公园，也可以变成下一排房子。

tip: in the wild 表示在野外。wild 也可作名词“荒野”。

senses.en: not having, or not doing

ex.en: He finished the paper without a single mistake.
ex.zh: 他交卷时一个错误都没有。

ex.en: A city cannot cut car use without giving people buses and pavements they can trust.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公交和人行道，一座城市就无法减少私家车使用。

tip: without 后接名词或 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: a father

ex.en: My dad picks me up on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我爸爸周五来接我。

ex.en: A dad who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的爸爸可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: dad 是口语；正式写作可用 father。

senses.en: related to society or to meeting people

ex.en: We did a social study on how neighbours share tools.
ex.zh: 我们做了一项关于邻居如何共用工具的社会调查。

ex.en: Social media can connect a class, but it can also spread a rumour in minutes.
ex.zh: 社交媒体能把一个班联系起来，也能在几分钟内传播谣言。

tip: social 是形容词；社会用 society。

senses.en: a single part, or a standard of measurement

ex.en: We finished unit three today.
ex.zh: 我们今天学完了第三单元。

ex.en: A small clinic is a useful unit of care when the hospital is an hour away.
ex.zh: 当医院在一小时之外时，小诊所是有用的医疗单位。

tip: unit 是可数名词。

senses.en: having great power or effect

ex.en: The speech was short but powerful.
ex.zh: 这次发言很短，但很有力量。

ex.en: A powerful poster can change a habit only if the school also changes the choice in the canteen.
ex.zh: 有力的海报只有在学校同时改变食堂的选择时，才可能改变习惯。

tip: powerful 可形容人、机器、话语或效果。

senses.en: an opening or a hollow place

ex.en: There is a hole in the fence.
ex.zh: 篱笆上有一个洞。

ex.en: A hole in the playground should be marked before the first class, not after someone falls.
ex.zh: 操场上的坑应当在第一节课之前标出来，而不是等有人摔倒之后。

tip: hole 可数。in the hole 有时比喻亏空。

senses.en: to find the size or amount
an action, or a unit of size

ex.en: Measure the table before you buy the cloth.
ex.zh: 买布之前先量桌子。

ex.en: Cities should measure the air near schools, not only in the park.
ex.zh: 城市应当测量学校附近的空气，而不只是公园里的。

tip: measure 作名词是措施或度量。take measures to do 表示采取措施。

senses.en: a drawing or photograph

ex.en: Draw a picture of your street.
ex.zh: 画一张你的街道。

ex.en: A picture of a clean river can hide the factory that still pours waste at night.
ex.zh: 一张干净河流的照片，可以藏起仍在夜里排污的工厂。

tip: picture 作动词是“想象”。

senses.en: an early version of a piece of writing
to write an early version

ex.en: Hand in a draft before the final essay.
ex.zh: 交定稿前先交一份草稿。

ex.en: A draft budget lets parents see the numbers before they are locked.
ex.zh: 预算草案让家长在数字定死之前看见它们。

tip: draft 作动词是起草。美式 draft 也可指征兵，本条以草稿为主。

senses.en: a result you aim at

ex.en: Our target is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A target that ignores poorer schools can make a city average look successful and still leave them behind.
ex.zh: 忽视较穷学校的目标，可以让城市平均数看起来成功，那些学校却仍被落下。

tip: target 作动词是“以……为目标”。

senses.en: a young person

ex.en: Every child in the class has a reading book.
ex.zh: 班上每个孩子都有一本读物。

ex.en: A child who walks to school needs a pavement, not only a parent with a car.
ex.zh: 走路上学的孩子需要人行道，而不只是一位有车的家长。

tip: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。

senses.en: a type or sort
friendly and helpful

ex.en: What kind of book do you like?
ex.zh: 你喜欢哪一类书？

ex.en: The kind of food sold at a school gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
ex.zh: 校门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。

tip: kind 作形容词是“善良的”：be kind to sb。

senses.en: of the sun, or using its energy

ex.en: The solar clock in the yard still works.
ex.zh: 院子里的太阳钟还能用。

ex.en: Solar power on a school roof helps only if someone can repair it.
ex.zh: 学校屋顶的太阳能只有在有人能修的时候才有帮助。

tip: solar 是形容词。名词太阳是 the sun。

senses.en: a way of entering or using
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Students need access to the library.
ex.zh: 学生需要使用图书馆的权限。

ex.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: the possibility of becoming something
possible in the future

ex.en: The club helps students find their potential.
ex.zh: 社团帮助学生发现自己的潜力。

ex.en: The potential of an empty building is a clinic or a library, if the town chooses that use.
ex.zh: 一座空楼的潜力是诊所或图书馆，如果城镇选择那样使用。

tip: potential 也可作形容词“潜在的”。

senses.en: different from

ex.en: Unlike the morning bus, the later one stops here.
ex.zh: 和早班车不同，晚班车在这里停。

ex.en: Unlike a poster, a working clock tells you whether you are late.
ex.zh: 和海报不同，一块能走的钟会告诉你是否迟到了。

tip: unlike 是介词。形容词 unlike 表示不同的，较少用。

senses.en: a disagreement; a reason
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: Their argument lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时。

ex.en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

senses.en: an official instruction
to govern

ex.en: The lab rule is to wear glasses.
ex.zh: 实验室的规则是戴眼镜。

ex.en: A rule against litter works when bins are near and everyone can see it applied.
ex.zh: 当附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都看到规则被执行时，禁止乱扔的规则才有效。

tip: rule 作动词是“统治”。

senses.en: feeling pleased about something you or others did

ex.en: Her parents are proud of her speech.
ex.zh: 她父母为她的演讲感到自豪。

ex.en: A school can be proud of a garden and still admit who did the watering.
ex.zh: 学校可以为花园自豪，同时承认是谁浇的水。

tip: be proud of 后接名词或 doing。骄傲过头时 proud 含贬义，要看语境。

senses.en: money received from work or other sources

ex.en: Rent takes a large part of their income.
ex.zh: 房租占了他们收入的很大一部分。

ex.en: When food prices rise, low income leaves less money for books and clinic visits.
ex.zh: 食品涨价时，低收入会让书和看病的钱更少。

tip: income 可数或不可数都可以。

senses.en: easy to understand or do

ex.en: Please use simple words in the notice.
ex.zh: 通知里请用简单的词。

ex.en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。

tip: simple 的副词是 simply。

senses.en: not anything

ex.en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
ex.zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。

ex.en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
ex.zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。

tip: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

senses.en: the story of a book or film

ex.en: The plot is simple and the ending is not.
ex.zh: 情节简单，结局并不简单。

ex.en: A plot about a flood should not hide who had to leave their house.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的情节不应当藏起谁不得不离开自己的家。

tip: plot 也可指小块土地，或密谋。作动词是密谋或绘制。本条以故事情节为主。

senses.en: until now, often in questions and negatives
but at the same time

ex.en: She has not finished the poster yet.
ex.zh: 她还没有完成海报。

ex.en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
ex.zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。

tip: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

senses.en: strong trust, or a religion

ex.en: She has faith in the team's hard work.
ex.zh: 她相信队伍的努力。

ex.en: Public rules should protect every faith without making one of them the school rule.
ex.zh: 公共规则应当保护每一种信仰，而不把其中一种变成校规。

tip: faith 可指对人的信任，也可指宗教信仰。

senses.en: a part of a tree, or a local office

ex.en: A branch fell across the path.
ex.zh: 一根树枝横在小路上。

ex.en: The library branch near the station stays open after the main one closes.
ex.zh: 车站附近的图书馆分馆，在总馆关门后还开着。

tip: branch 可指树枝、分公司、支部或学科分支。

senses.en: a covering for the head

ex.en: Take off your hat in the hall.
ex.zh: 在礼堂里摘下帽子。

ex.en: A hat in strong sun is a health tool, not only a fashion.
ex.zh: 烈日下的帽子是健康用具，而不只是打扮。

tip: hat 通常有边。cap 多指无边或只有前面有沿的帽子，本批另有词条。

senses.en: to become smaller in amount
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: in or to any place

ex.en: You may sit anywhere in the front two rows.
ex.zh: 前两排你可以随便坐。

ex.en: A student who cannot find anywhere quiet will not finish the same essay as a classmate with a desk.
ex.zh: 找不到安静地方的学生，完成不了和有书桌的同学同样的作文。

tip: anywhere 多用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句常用 somewhere。

senses.en: a piece of cloth used as a symbol

ex.en: The flag is raised at eight.
ex.zh: 旗在八点升起。

ex.en: A flag at the gate does not tell a new student where the clinic is.
ex.zh: 门口的旗告诉不了新生医务室在哪里。

tip: flag 作动词可以是标出或衰退。国旗前常用 the。

senses.en: a spoken or written remark
to give an opinion

ex.en: She left a short comment under the article.
ex.zh: 她在文章下面留了一条短评。

ex.en: A rude comment online can follow a student longer than the lesson it interrupted.
ex.zh: 网上一句粗鲁的评论，可能比它打断的那节课跟学生更久。

tip: comment 作动词时，说 comment on something。

senses.en: the chance of something bad
to do something that may cause harm

ex.en: There is a risk of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午有下雨的风险。

ex.en: The risk of flooding rises when a town builds houses on the cheapest land beside a river.
ex.zh: 当城镇把房子建在河边最便宜的地上时，洪水风险会上升。

tip: risk doing 表示冒险做可能带来坏结果的事。

senses.en: existing in nature, or normal

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。

ex.en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
ex.zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。

tip: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

senses.en: a plan of times
to plan a time for something

ex.en: The schedule is on the door.
ex.zh: 时间表在门上。

ex.en: A schedule that ignores the last bus will look neat and still fail.
ex.zh: 不考虑末班车的日程看起来整齐，仍然会失败。

tip: 英式常读 /ˈʃedjuːl/，美式常读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。作动词是安排。

senses.en: a mistake
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have

ex.en: Please keep the door closed.
ex.zh: 请让门保持关着。

ex.en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
ex.zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。

tip: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

senses.en: on the side opposite the right

senses.zh: 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）
senses.en: past form of leave

ex.en: Turn left after the school gate.
ex.zh: 出校门后向左转。

ex.en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
ex.zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。

tip: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

senses.en: a person who uses something

ex.en: The user guide is on the desk.
ex.zh: 用户指南在桌子上。

ex.en: A library user who cannot log in still needs a way to borrow a book.
ex.zh: 登不进去的图书馆用户，仍然需要一种借书的办法。

tip: user 可数。计算机和图书馆都可以用。

senses.en: the area around a place; American spelling

ex.en: The neighborhood shares one clinic.
ex.zh: 这个街区共用一家诊所。

ex.en: A quiet neighborhood can still be far from the last bus.
ex.zh: 安静的街区仍然可能离末班车很远。

tip: neighborhood 是美式。英式是 neighbourhood。本库用考纲里的 neighborhood。

senses.en: to move something into a place

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: If a city puts all new housing on the edge, workers spend hours travelling to jobs in the centre.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市把新住房都放在边缘，工人就要花数小时去市中心上班。

tip: put 的过去式和过去分词都是 put，不是 putted。

senses.en: to put a name on an official list
an official list, or a person who keeps it

ex.en: Please register before the first class.
ex.zh: 第一节课前请登记。

ex.en: A school that can register a new student in one morning keeps that child in class the same day.
ex.zh: 能在一个上午给新生登记的学校，能让那个孩子当天就上课。

tip: register 作名词是登记簿或注册员。

senses.en: to rescue, to avoid spending, or to keep

ex.en: Save your work before you close the computer.
ex.zh: 关电脑前先保存作业。

ex.en: Towns that save old trees save shade that new saplings cannot give for years.
ex.zh: 保住老树的城镇，也保住了新树苗多年内给不了的荫凉。

tip: save 表示拯救或节省，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: to fasten or join
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
ex.zh: 请把照片附在表格上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: used for a possibility that is not certain

ex.en: It might snow tonight, so take a coat.
ex.zh: 今晚可能会下雪，带件外套。

ex.en: A new subway line might help the centre while making outer villages feel even farther away.
ex.zh: 一条新地铁线可能方便市中心，同时让外围村庄感觉更远。

tip: might 比 may 语气更不确定，两者后面都接动词原形。

senses.en: a high opinion, or regard for someone's rights
to admire and treat well

ex.en: Students show respect by listening.
ex.zh: 学生用倾听来表示尊重。

ex.en: Respect for local knowledge means asking residents where the flood actually reached.
ex.zh: 尊重本地知识，意味着询问居民洪水实际淹到了哪里。

tip: respect 作动词直接接宾语：respect sb。

senses.en: the bottom support, or a main place
to use something as the starting point

ex.en: Trust is the base of the club.
ex.zh: 信任是这个社团的基础。

ex.en: A flood plan with no local base of volunteers will be slow on the first wet night.
ex.zh: 没有本地志愿者基础的防汛计划，会在第一个雨夜行动迟缓。

tip: be based on 表示以……为基础。base 作动词是“以……为根据”。

senses.en: a light artificial material
made of plastic

ex.en: The bottle is plastic, not glass.
ex.zh: 这个瓶子是塑料的，不是玻璃的。

ex.en: Plastic that leaves the school bin can reach a river if nobody stops it.
ex.zh: 离开学校垃圾桶的塑料，如果没人拦住，可以一直到河里。

tip: plastic 作材料时常不可数。作形容词是塑料的。

senses.en: in the direction of, or in relation to

ex.en: We walked towards the gate.
ex.zh: 我们朝校门走去。

ex.en: Attitudes towards night buses change when people have to use them themselves.
ex.zh: 当人们不得不自己去坐夜班公交时，他们对它的态度会改变。

tip: 英式常用 towards，美式常用 toward，意思相同。

senses.en: to keep safe from harm

ex.en: Trees protect the playground from the sun.
ex.zh: 树木保护操场不受日晒。

ex.en: Laws that protect a river also protect the drinking water of the next town.
ex.zh: 保护河流的法律，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。

col: protect sb from｜保护某人免受
tip: protect 后接宾语，再加 from 或 against。

senses.en: unusual, or not familiar

ex.en: The noise was strange for a Sunday.
ex.zh: 这声音在周日很奇怪。

ex.en: A strange result in one lab is a reason to measure again, not to hide the page.
ex.zh: 一次实验里奇怪的结果，是再测一次的理由，不是把那页藏起来。

tip: stranger 是陌生人。feel strange 可表示不舒服。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay

ex.en: The hotel near the station is full.
ex.zh: 车站附近的旅馆满了。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill every hotel while ordinary rents rise for the rest of the year.
ex.zh: 大型体育赛事可以住满每家旅馆，同时让普通房租在这一年的其余时间上涨。

tip: hotel 是可数名词。

senses.en: serious pain or difficulty

ex.en: The novel does not describe the suffering in detail.
ex.zh: 小说没有详细描写那些痛苦。

ex.en: Flood suffering is reduced by a dry room, not only by a speech.
ex.zh: 洪水带来的苦难靠一间干房间来减轻，而不只是靠一篇讲话。

tip: suffering 可数也可不可数。动词 suffer from 表示患有或遭受。

senses.en: clever, or neat and fashionable

ex.en: That was a smart way to save time.
ex.zh: 那是个省时间的聪明办法。

ex.en: A smart uniform does not tell a teacher who prepared and who copied.
ex.zh: 整齐时髦的校服并不能告诉老师谁做了准备、谁抄了作业。

tip: smart 可指聪明，也可指衣着整齐时髦。美式口语里很常见。

senses.en: to try to find or get

ex.en: They seek advice before they change the rule.
ex.zh: 他们在改规则之前寻求建议。

ex.en: Students who seek help early avoid the week when the work is already late.
ex.zh: 早点求助的学生，能避开作业已经迟了的那一周。

tip: seek 的过去式和过去分词是 sought。比 look for 正式。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste water.
ex.zh: 我们浪费不起水。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: an edge, a face, or one of two groups

ex.en: Please write notes on the side of the page.
ex.zh: 请把笔记写在页边。

ex.en: Both sides of a noisy road need a safe crossing if children walk to school there.
ex.zh: 如果孩子从那里走路上学，嘈杂马路的两边都需要安全的过街处。

col: on the other side｜在另一边
tip: side 是名词；旁边用 beside 或 by the side of。

senses.en: a thing you can see or touch, an aim, or a grammar object
to say that you disagree

ex.en: The object on the desk is a model.
ex.zh: 桌上的物体是一个模型。

ex.en: The object of the rule is safety, and the sign should say that.
ex.zh: 这条规则的目的是安全，牌子上应当写出来。

tip: 名词物体读 /ˈɒbdʒɪkt/。动词反对读 /əbˈdʒekt/，后接 to doing。

senses.en: pleasant to look at
fairly

ex.en: The pretty garden is behind the hall.
ex.zh: 漂亮的花园在大厅后面。

ex.en: A pretty river view does not mean the water is clean enough for children to play in.
ex.zh: 河景漂亮并不意味着水干净到可以让孩子玩。

tip: pretty 作副词表示“相当”，语气比 very 弱。

senses.en: worry caused by difficulty, or special importance
to give special importance

ex.en: Exam stress is common in May.
ex.zh: 五月考试压力很常见。

ex.en: Teachers who stress sleep as well as scores give students a fairer message.
ex.zh: 同时强调睡眠和分数的老师，给学生的信息更公平。

tip: stress 作动词是强调。语音里的重读也叫 stress。

senses.en: easy to understand or see
to remove, or to become bright

ex.en: Please write a clear title.
ex.zh: 请写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: Clear signs at a junction matter more at night, when drivers and children share a narrow road.
ex.zh: 路口清楚的标志在夜里更重要，那时司机和孩子共用一条窄路。

tip: clear 作动词是“清除”或“放晴”。It is clear that...

senses.en: using numbers, or stored as computer data

ex.en: The digital clock in the hall is wrong.
ex.zh: 大厅里的数字钟不准。

ex.en: Digital notes are easy to share and easy to lose if nobody keeps a copy.
ex.zh: 数字笔记容易分享，如果没人留备份也容易丢失。

tip: digital 与 analogue 相对。不要和 traditional 的反义 modern 混用。

senses.en: a government department

ex.en: The ministry published the new school rule.
ex.zh: 该部公布了新的学校规定。

ex.en: A ministry that funds buses should also say which villages are left out.
ex.zh: 资助公交的部，也应当说明哪些村子被落下了。

tip: ministry 可数。部长是 minister，已在本库。

senses.en: a hard clear material, or a cup made of it

ex.en: There is a glass of water on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯水。

ex.en: Broken glass on a playground is a safety problem, not only a cleaning job.
ex.zh: 操场上的碎玻璃是安全问题，不只是打扫的事。

tip: glass 作材料不可数。a glass 是一只杯子。眼镜用复数 glasses。

senses.en: the group of people who govern a country or city

ex.en: The government plans to repair the old bridge.
ex.zh: 政府计划修缮那座旧桥。

ex.en: A local government that publishes its spending makes it easier for citizens to ask useful questions.
ex.zh: 公开支出的地方政府，让公民更容易提出有用的问题。

tip: government 作整体时谓语常用单数。

senses.en: one time, or at some time in the past
as soon as

ex.en: I have been to the museum only once.
ex.zh: 我只去过一次博物馆。

ex.en: Once a wetland is filled in for housing, the birds do not return just because a sign says they are welcome.
ex.zh: 一旦湿地被填平用来建房，鸟儿不会因为一块欢迎的牌子就回来。

tip: once 引导条件从句时表示“一旦”，主句常用将来或情态。

senses.en: just, or reasonably good
an outdoor sale or exhibition

ex.en: The rule is fair if it applies to everyone.
ex.zh: 如果规则适用于所有人，它就是公平的。

ex.en: A fair chance to learn includes a quiet room, not only an equal test paper.
ex.zh: 公平的学习机会包括一间安静的房间，而不只是一份相同的试卷。

tip: fair 作名词是“集市、义卖”。

senses.en: important; large
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem.
ex.zh: 交通是一个重大问题。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: a written message, or a sign in the alphabet

ex.en: I wrote a letter to my cousin.
ex.zh: 我给表哥写了一封信。

ex.en: A letter to the council should name the street and the problem, not only the feeling.
ex.zh: 给市政会的信应该写明街道和问题，而不只是情绪。

tip: letter 的两个常见义是信和字母。

senses.en: unpleasant, poor, or serious

ex.en: The weather was bad, so the match was delayed.
ex.zh: 天气不好，比赛推迟了。

ex.en: Bad air on the walk to school can harm children even when their classrooms are clean.
ex.zh: 即使教室很干净，上学路上的糟糕空气仍可能伤害孩子。

tip: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst，不是 more bad。

senses.en: to kick or throw toward a goal, or to take a photograph
a new growth, or an act of firing

ex.en: She can shoot from the corner.
ex.zh: 她能从角球位置射门。

ex.en: Students may not shoot photos during an exam, even if the phone is already in their hand.
ex.zh: 即使手机已经拿在手里，考试时学生也不可以拍照。

tip: shoot 的过去式和过去分词是 shot。名词还可指嫩芽。射击是词典里的另一个意思；本库不写操作方法。

senses.en: an order
to order, or to be in charge

ex.en: The captain gave a clear command.
ex.zh: 队长下了一道清楚的命令。

ex.en: A command that nobody understands is not safer than a short explanation.
ex.zh: 谁也听不懂的命令，并不比一句短说明更安全。

col: at one command｜听某人的命令
tip: command 作动词是命令。计算机里的指令也叫 command。

senses.en: familiar with something, or not new

ex.en: I am used to getting up early on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我习惯早起。

ex.en: A used textbook can be as useful as a new one if the notes in the margin are clear.
ex.zh: 如果页边的笔记清楚，旧课本可以和新的一样有用。

col: be used to do｜被用来做
tip: used to do 是过去常常；be used to doing 是习惯于。不要混用。

senses.en: something you use to do a job

ex.en: The tool is on the bench.
ex.zh: 工具在工作台上。

ex.en: A map is a tool, and so is the person who knows which stop is safe at night.
ex.zh: 地图是工具，知道哪个车站夜里安全的人也是。

tip: tool 可数。计算机里的工具也叫 tool。

senses.en: a particular published form of a book or paper

ex.en: We use the new edition of the textbook.
ex.zh: 我们用这本教材的新版。

ex.en: The evening edition of the paper corrected a name that the morning edition had wrong.
ex.zh: 晚报更正了早报写错的一个名字。

tip: edition 是一版出版物。软件或文本的另一种形式也可用 version。

senses.en: to try hard to do something difficult
a hard effort

ex.en: He struggled to hear at the back.
ex.zh: 他在后排努力想听清。

ex.en: Students who struggle with one subject still belong in the lab.
ex.zh: 某一科吃力的学生，仍然应当进实验室。

tip: struggle 也可作名词。后接 to do 表示费力地做。

senses.en: the making of goods, or a branch of business

ex.en: The town grew around the steel industry.
ex.zh: 这个城镇是围绕钢铁工业发展起来的。

ex.en: An industry beside a river should pay for the water it dirties, not only for the jobs it creates.
ex.zh: 河边的工业应该为它弄脏的水付费，而不只为它创造的工作。

tip: industry 的复数是 industries。

senses.en: and not, used after a negative

ex.en: He cannot swim, nor can his brother.
ex.zh: 他不会游泳，他弟弟也不会。

ex.en: The hall has neither a ramp nor a clear sign, so some parents never come in.
ex.zh: 礼堂既没有坡道，也没有清楚的标志，所以有些家长从不进来。

tip: neither...nor 连接并列成分。nor 放在句首时，后面的句子常用倒装。or 已在排除的虚词里，nor 作为考纲词头保留。

senses.en: the part of the face used for breathing and smelling

ex.en: Cover your nose when you sneeze.
ex.zh: 打喷嚏时捂住鼻子。

ex.en: A nosebleed in class is a reason to call the clinic, not to laugh.
ex.zh: 课上流鼻血是叫医务室的理由，不是嘲笑的理由。

tip: nose 可数。

senses.en: a person who controls a business or team

ex.en: The shop manager checked the list.
ex.zh: 店经理核对了清单。

ex.en: A hospital manager who walks the night ward sees problems a report can miss.
ex.zh: 走夜班病房的医院经理，能看到报告可能漏掉的问题。

tip: manager 是人；management 是管理这个工作。

senses.en: the top of the body, or the person in charge
to go towards, or to lead

ex.en: She nodded her head to show she understood.
ex.zh: 她点头表示听懂了。

ex.en: A club needs a head who listens, or the loudest member will decide everything.
ex.zh: 社团需要一个肯听意见的负责人，否则声音最大的人会决定一切。

col: from head to foot｜从头到脚
tip: head for 表示朝某地去。head 作动词是“前往”或“率领”。

senses.en: on the day before today
the day before today

ex.en: Yesterday we practised the play in the hall.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在大厅里排戏。

ex.en: A storm yesterday closed two roads, so some students arrived after the first lesson.
ex.zh: 昨天的暴风雨封了两条路，所以有些学生第一节课后才到。

tip: yesterday 前不用介词，不说 on yesterday。

senses.en: a thing that is not named

ex.en: There is something wrong with the clock.
ex.zh: 这只钟有点问题。

ex.en: Something as small as a leaked battery can pollute the soil around a school for years.
ex.zh: 一块泄漏的电池这样小的东西，也可能污染学校周围的土壤很多年。

tip: 形容词放在 something 后面：something important。
